messages:
Maya (PR): Heads-up: launch date confirmed 2027-05-12. We need a final press/analyst outreach plan by Thu EOD. Proposed embargo: 09:00 PT. Who will own quote approvals and fact-check gating?
Ethan (Growth): I can manage calendar & press routing. Need final quote by Tue COB to populate invites.
Lena (Product): Benchmarks draft in drive: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-release/benchmarks/draft.md. PR please check cost-vs-latency phrasing.
Tom (Engineering): Perf run scheduled Mon morning. If numbers change, I'll update CSV at s3://redwood-release/benchmarks/data.csv.
Maya (PR): Legal sign-off needed @Noah. Also want a 24h fact-check window for analysts post-embargo.
Noah (Legal): Send quote draft. Legal prefers hedged language, and we require a short fact-check NDA for pre-embargo deep dives.
Sofia (Sales): For inbound routing: add a lead tag rule in the kit: press-2027-launch. Analysts -> AE handoff, Press -> SDRs. I can draft the playbook.
Ethan (Growth): Suggested briefing length: 20 minutes (10m demo, 10m Q&A). APAC availability limited; offer EOD PT and 08:00 APAC slots.
Lena (Product): We'll prepare two benchmark slides and a condensed demo for 20-min slots.
Maya (PR): Draft quote: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency LLM serving at scale. In our benchmarks we observed median token latency of ~X ms and cost improvements of ~Y% versus baseline." Please paste edits inline.
Noah (Legal): Add boilerplate: "Results may vary by workload and configuration." Avoid absolutes. I'll review after edits.
press-bot: Calendar invites created for confirmed slots (Wed 10:00 PT, Thu 16:00 CET).
Aria (Ops): Reminder: update press kit S3 with final CSV and quote template after freeze.
Maya (PR): Timeline quick list:
- Mon 09:00 PT: perf freeze (Tom)
- Mon EOD: quote draft in doc (Maya)
- Tue noon: calendar poll closes (all)
- Wed morning: lock briefing schedule (Ethan)
- Wed EOD: Legal sign-off (Noah)
- Thu: briefings begin
Please react with :thumbsup: for owned items.
Ethan (Growth): :thumbsup: scheduling.
Lena (Product): :thumbsup: slides.
Tom (Engineering): :thumbsup: perf freeze.
Noah (Legal): :thumbsup: will review.
Sofia (Sales): :thumbsup: will draft playbook.
Maya (PR): Thanks — ping here immediately if perf numbers force timeline changes or embargo shifts.
